summary.method:
build_tax.py - tax_table.json: per coin traded by the Blood/copy backtests (tokens.json, 11,488 coins).
MEASURED: >= 1 usable receipt of a real swap. Token tax per row = taxcoin.token_tax (the token paying itself / burning /
a V2-V3 pool paying a third wallet). Coin buy/sell tax = median of that side's rows; a missing side copies the other side
(flag side_inferred). TAXED if any side >= 0.1 %.
FAMILY-INFERRED: unmeasured coin whose launchpad family has >= 8 measured coins and ZERO taxed -> untaxed (family), or,
if the family has taxed coins, 'unknown' with the family's measured prevalence and median tax attached (expected value).
